Bangladesh Faces Severe Measles Outbreak with Over 1,000 Child Deaths

Bangladesh is experiencing its worst measles outbreak in years, with over 50,000 confirmed or suspected cases reported this year. The death toll among children has surpassed 1,000. Authorities are working to bring the escalating outbreak under control. The situation has drawn international attention due to its severity and the number of child fatalities.
